link.7652579600f1.source:
Discovery is a trust boundary. Treat a tools/list response as untrusted input. Before connecting the server:
  • verify its identity,
  • show the requested capabilities to the user,
  • grant the smallest useful scope,
  • and bind each credential to that server's audience.
For remote connection and OAuth discovery, reject private and link-local destinations and validate every redirect. The MCP security guidance assigns consent, token handling, and server-side request forgery (SSRF) controls to the client.
link.7652579600f1.value:
发现过程也是信任边界。请将 tools/list 响应视为不可信输入。连接服务器之前：
  • 验证其身份，
  • 向用户显示所请求的能力，
  • 授予满足使用需求的最小权限范围，
  • 并将每项凭据绑定到该服务器对应的受众。
对于远程连接和 OAuth 发现，请拒绝私有地址和链路本地地址，并验证每一次重定向。 MCP 安全指南要求客户端负责用户同意、token 处理以及服务器端请求伪造（SSRF）控制。

rich.5e60c782fb3e.source: Model Context Protocol (MCP) gives tool serving a standard shape. The agent retrieves a server's catalog with tools/list and invokes a selected entry with tools/call. Those tools live in a separate process that the agent connects to and queries when it starts up. Because the protocol is the same everywhere, the agent can connect to additional servers without learning a new interface for each one. Use MCP when tool discovery and transport need a shared protocol. Use a local function, a repo skill, or a direct API call when the harness already knows where the capability lives and how to invoke it.
rich.5e60c782fb3e.value: Model Context Protocol (MCP) 为工具服务提供了标准形式。智能体通过 tools/list 获取服务器的工具目录，并通过 tools/call 调用所选条目。这些工具运行在独立进程中，智能体启动时会连接该进程并进行查询。由于各处采用相同协议，智能体无需为每台服务器学习新的接口，即可连接更多服务器。当工具发现和传输需要共享协议时，请使用 MCP。如果执行框架已经知道能力的位置和调用方式，则使用本地函数、仓库技能或直接的 API 调用。

rich.6409a1729518.source: The page follows that contract from local functions to a search backend and a sub-agent. A sub-agent as a tool places one focused agent behind a single schema so the outer workflow can route work without exposing every internal capability. Model Context Protocol (MCP) gives a client a standard way to discover and call tools served by another process. Use it at a capability boundary, after validating the server, identity, and scope. Both patterns keep the main loop's tool list small and motivate Module 2's scoped workflows.
